about: Which RedFoxOS image suits a computer, from its PCI display devices (vendor and device id, lower-case hex without 0x). The one rule set for RedFox Hub's '(Recommended)' (redfox-rollback-helper) and the download page on redfoxlabs.tech. Each display device gets the first class it matches (in order), or 'other'; then the first rule whose 'all' classes are all present and whose 'none' classes are all absent gives the answer. image null means no recommendation. hybrid marks built-in graphics next to an NVIDIA card (a laptop, usually). Test cases: tests/gpu-cases.json.

classes.note: Turing and newer: GTX 16xx, RTX 20xx and newer
Maxwell, Pascal and Volta: GTX 750, GTX 900 and GTX 10xx; NVIDIA's legacy driver
older than Maxwell (Kepler, Fermi and before): no NVIDIA driver for current systems

rules.why: an NVIDIA GTX 16xx, RTX 20xx or newer card, with built-in graphics
an NVIDIA GTX 16xx, RTX 20xx or newer card
an NVIDIA GTX 900 or 1000 series card, with built-in graphics
an NVIDIA GTX 900 or 1000 series card
an NVIDIA card older than the GTX 900 series, which NVIDIA's drivers no longer support, so it runs on the open-source driver built into RedFoxOS
graphics it doesn't recognise (a virtual machine?)
